_note: Chapter 21 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: He accepted the offer of a place at the university without hesitation.
ex.cn: 他毫不犹豫地接受了大学录取通知。
ex.note: accept an offer 接受提议；accept that … 承认…

ex.en: The farm covers two hundred acres of wheat fields.
ex.cn: 这座农场占地两百英亩，全是麦田。
ex.note: acres of … 若干英亩的…

ex.en: Try to keep the number of adverbs in your writing as small as possible.
ex.cn: 尽量少在你写的文章里用副词。
ex.note: an adverb of time/manner 时间/方式副词

ex.en: The museum displays an old aircraft that once flew over the harbour.
ex.cn: 博物馆陈列着一架曾经飞越港口的老飞机。
ex.note: aircraft 单复数同形

ex.en: He works as an ambassador for a national road-safety programme.
ex.cn: 他是全国道路安全计划的宣传代表。
ex.note: an ambassador for … …的代言人

ex.en: We did not anticipate such a strong reaction to the news.
ex.cn: 我们没有料到这条消息会引起如此强烈的反应。
ex.note: anticipate doing 预料会做；anticipate that … 预料…

ex.en: She appreciated his offer of help and shook his hand warmly.
ex.cn: 她感激他的援手，热情地握了握他的手。
ex.note: I would appreciate it if … 如果…我将不胜感激

ex.en: Her sketch of the harbour was simple but strongly artistic.
ex.cn: 她画的那幅海港速写简洁，却很有艺术味道。
ex.note: artistic sense 艺术感；artistic style 艺术风格

ex.en: Hackers attacked the server through a forgotten back door.
ex.cn: 黑客通过一扇被遗忘的后门攻击了服务器。
ex.note: attack a problem 着手解决难题

ex.en: She put her phone away when the lecture began.
ex.cn: 讲座开始时，她把手机收了起来。
ex.note: away from 远离；far away 在远处

ex.en: The jacket was a real bargain at half the usual price.
ex.cn: 这件夹克只卖平常价钱的一半，算是一笔便宜货。
ex.note: at a bargain price 以便宜价；a good bargain 划算的买卖

ex.en: She bargained with the seller until the price came down by a third.
ex.cn: 她和卖家讨价还价，直到价钱降了三分之一。
ex.note: bargain with sb. 与某人讨价还价

ex.en: The beauty of the old quarter is hard to put into words.
ex.cn: 老城区的美很难用言语形容。
ex.note: the beauty of … …的美

ex.en: She sat beside the window and watched the traffic.
ex.cn: 她坐在窗边，看着车流。
ex.note: beside oneself 忘乎所以；beside the point 离题

ex.en: A blast from the loudspeaker silenced the whole hall.
ex.cn: 扩音器里炸出的一声巨响让全场安静下来。
ex.note: a blast of wind 一阵疾风；a blast of noise 一阵噪音

ex.en: The old computers were blasted with a hammer before being recycled.
ex.cn: 这些旧电脑在回收之前被锤子砸烂了。
ex.note: blast sth. with … 用…砸毁某物

ex.en: The lecture on insurance turned out to be rather boring.
ex.cn: 那场关于保险的讲座结果相当无聊。
ex.note: boring to sb. 对某人来说无聊

ex.en: The bride wore a simple white dress to the ceremony.
ex.cn: 新娘穿着一身素净的白裙子出席婚礼。

ex.en: The little shop is doing good business since the new road opened.
ex.cn: 新路开通以后，这家小店生意兴隆。
ex.note: do business with 与…做生意；business hours 营业时间

ex.en: The bank agreed to cancel the card once she proved her identity.
ex.cn: 她证明身份之后，银行同意注销那张卡。
ex.note: cancel a meeting 取消会议；cancel a subscription 退订

ex.en: The cashier asked whether we wanted a receipt.
ex.cn: 收银员问我们要不要收据。

ex.en: A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
ex.cn: 一柄锁链的强度，只等于它最弱的那一环。
ex.note: a chain of events 一连串事件；a chain of shops 连锁店

ex.en: He chained his bicycle to the railings outside the library.
ex.cn: 他把自行车用铁链锁在图书馆外的栏杆上。
ex.note: chain oneself to 把自己束缚于

ex.en: She wrote out a cheque for the rent and handed it to the landlord.
ex.cn: 她开了一张付房租的支票，递给了房东。
ex.note: pay by cheque 用支票支付；cheque book 支票簿

ex.en: Local citizens were told to report anything strange to the police.
ex.cn: 当地市民被告知，遇到任何可疑情况都要报警。
ex.note: a citizen of … …的居民；citizens' rights 公民权利

ex.en: She folded the clothes that had been left in the machine since morning.
ex.cn: 她把早上就留在洗衣机里的衣服叠好。
ex.note: a change of clothes 一套换洗衣服

ex.en: The website is protected by a combination of password and one-time code.
ex.cn: 这家网站由密码加一次性验证码的组合来保护。
ex.note: a combination of … …的组合

ex.en: She is a competent engineer who never misses a detail.
ex.cn: 她是一位称职的工程师，从不放过任何细节。
ex.note: be competent for/in … 胜任…

ex.en: The teacher asked us for concrete examples rather than general ideas.
ex.cn: 老师要我们举出具体的例子，而不是笼统的想法。
ex.note: concrete measures 具体措施

ex.en: The steps at the entrance are made of grey concrete.
ex.cn: 入口处的台阶是灰色的混凝土做的。
ex.note: reinforced concrete 钢筋混凝土

ex.en: Have you considered what you would do if the account were emptied?
ex.cn: 你想过没有，如果账户里的钱被掏空，你会怎么办？
ex.note: consider doing 考虑做；consider sb. for sth. 考虑某人担任…

ex.en: The students contributed books to the reading room at the end of term.
ex.cn: 学期末，学生们向阅览室捐了书。
ex.note: contribute to 促成；contribute to a journal 投稿

ex.en: We walked along the covered corridor towards the old theatre.
ex.cn: 我们沿着有顶的走廊朝老剧院走去。
ex.note: along the corridor 沿着走廊

ex.en: The server crashed twice before the engineers found the fault.
ex.cn: 工程师找出故障之前，服务器崩溃了两次。
ex.note: crash into 撞上；a plane crash 飞机失事

ex.en: Three boxes were stacked into a cube on the slide.
ex.cn: 幻灯片上，三个盒子叠成了一个立方体。
ex.note: ice cube 冰块；the cube of … …的立方

ex.en: Sharing a password with a stranger is a dangerous habit.
ex.cn: 和陌生人共用密码是个危险的习惯。
ex.note: it is dangerous to do 做…是危险的

ex.en: He left his passport on the deck of the ferry.
ex.cn: 他把护照落在了渡轮的甲板上。
ex.note: on deck 在甲板上；the upper deck 上层

ex.en: She demonstrated how easily a laptop can be copied in a crowded cafe.
ex.cn: 她演示了一台笔记本电脑在拥挤的咖啡馆里会多么轻易地被复制走。
ex.note: demonstrate that … 证明…；demonstrate sth. to sb. 向某人演示…

ex.en: One careless click destroyed the trust of a lifetime.
ex.cn: 一次不经意的点击毁掉了一辈子的信任。
ex.note: destroy sb.'s hope 摧毁某人的希望

ex.en: The real difficulty is not the technology but keeping a cool head.
ex.cn: 真正的难处不在技术，而在于保持冷静。
ex.note: with difficulty 费力地；in difficulty 陷入困境

ex.en: His discovery of the flaw changed the way the class was run.
ex.cn: 他对那个破绽的发现改变了这一堂课的组织方式。
ex.note: the discovery of … …的发现

ex.en: The class was split into two divisions: one to attack, one to defend.
ex.cn: 全班分成两队：一队进攻，一队防守。
ex.note: a division of … …的划分；the sales division 销售部

ex.en: A dozen messages arrived within two minutes.
ex.cn: 两分钟之内来了十二条消息。
ex.note: dozens of 许多；a dozen eggs 一打鸡蛋

ex.en: A long phrase you can remember is more durable than a short one you cannot.
ex.cn: 一句你记得住的长话，比一句你记不住的短话更经得起时间。
ex.note: durable materials 耐用材料；durable friendship 持久的友谊

ex.en: Every system has an edge, and the edge is usually a person.
ex.cn: 每个系统都有一个边缘，而那个边缘通常是一个人。
ex.note: on edge 紧张；have the edge over sb. 胜过某人

ex.en: Reusing the same password everywhere is an elementary mistake.
ex.cn: 到处重复使用同一个密码是个最基本的错误。
ex.note: elementary school 小学；elementary maths 基础数学

ex.en: Put the charger at the other end of the table, please.
ex.cn: 请把充电器放在桌子的另一头。
ex.note: at the end of 在…末尾；no end of 无数的

ex.en: The lecture ended with a simple rule about good passwords.
ex.cn: 讲座以一条关于好密码的简单规则结束。
ex.note: end up doing 最终成为；end with 以…告终

ex.en: The teacher called careless clicking an epidemic among students.
ex.cn: 老师把随意的点击称作学生中的一种流行病。
ex.note: an epidemic of … …的蔓延

ex.en: These epidemic games spread from one class to another.
ex.cn: 这些流行的小游戏在一个班传到另一个班。
ex.note: epidemic disease 传染病

ex.en: If one password is used everywhere, a thief gets everywhere too.
ex.cn: 如果一个密码到处都在用，小偷也就到处都能进。
ex.note: everywhere else 别处；everywhere in the world 全世界

ex.en: The historical exhibition opens on the first day of term.
ex.cn: 历史展览在开学第一天开幕。
ex.note: hold an exhibition 举办展览；on exhibition 展出中

ex.en: In extreme cases a single mistake can close a small business.
ex.cn: 在极端的情况下，一个错误就足以让一家小企业关门。
ex.note: extreme weather 极端天气；extreme measures 过激手段

ex.en: We must not go to extremes when we secure a computer system.
ex.cn: 保护计算机系统时，我们不能走极端。
ex.note: go to extremes 走极端；in the extreme 极至

ex.en: How far is the old theatre from the eastern gate?
ex.cn: 老剧场离东门有多远？
ex.note: far away 在远处；far better 好得多

ex.en: The fee for the course includes all the materials you need.
ex.cn: 这门课的学费包含你需要的所有材料。
ex.note: a service fee 服务费；charge a fee 收取费用

ex.en: The small shop lost all its financial records in a single night.
ex.cn: 这家小店在一夜之间丢失了全部财务记录。
ex.note: financial records 财务记录；financial difficulties 财务困难

ex.en: A small shop flourishes when its people look after one another.
ex.cn: 一家小店里的人彼此照应，这家小店就会兴旺起来。
ex.note: flourish in 在…中兴旺

ex.en: Do not forget to lock the door when you leave.
ex.cn: 离开时别忘了锁门。
ex.note: forget to do 忘记要做；forget doing 忘记做过

ex.en: Frequent attacks are usually clumsy, and that is good news.
ex.cn: 频繁的攻击往往都很粗糙，这是个好消息。
ex.note: a frequent visitor 常客；be a frequent feature of 是…的常见特点

ex.en: Furthermore, a reliable friend is the best alarm system you can have.
ex.cn: 此外，可靠的朋友就是你能有的最好的报警系统。
ex.note: 用于补充说明，句首常加逗号

ex.en: It is hard to tell a genuine message from a fake one.
ex.cn: 真消息和假消息很难分辨。
ex.note: genuine concern 真诚的关心；genuine article 真品

ex.en: She is good at spotting a false logo in a crowded inbox.
ex.cn: 她擅长在拥挤的收件箱里看出一个假商标。
ex.note: be good at 擅长；be good for 对…有益

ex.en: The lectures do more good than harm, which is the point of them.
ex.cn: 这些讲座带来的好处多于坏处，这正是它们的意义所在。
ex.note: goods 商品；for the good of 为了…的利益

ex.en: Few visitors to the old cemetery can read the names on the graves.
ex.cn: 到过这片老墓园的人很少能读懂墓碑上的名字。
ex.note: grave digger 掘墓人；from the grave 出自坟墓

ex.en: In extreme cases the consequences could be very grave.
ex.cn: 在极端的情况下，后果可能相当严重。
ex.note: grave consequences 严重的后果；a grave mistake 严重的错误

ex.en: Cyber crime leaves no gun and no blood behind.
ex.cn: 网络犯罪不会留下枪，也不会留下血。
ex.note: under the gun 在压力之下

ex.en: The punishment for the criminals was harsh, but the victims still paid.
ex.cn: 对罪犯的惩罚很严厉，可代价还是由受害者承担。
ex.note: harsh conditions 恶劣的条件；a harsh sound 刺耳的声音

ex.en: You do not want to learn this lesson in hell.
ex.cn: 你不会想在地狱里学到这一课。
ex.note: a hell of a … 极…的；make sb.'s life hell 让某人的日子很难过

ex.en: The exhibition collects objects of historical interest from the university's past.
ex.cn: 展览汇集了这所大学历史上颇具意义的各种物件。
ex.note: historical figures 历史人物；historical records 历史档案

ex.en: Hot tea and orange cake were served during the break.
ex.cn: 休息时供应了热茶和橙子蛋糕。
ex.note: hot topic 热门话题；hot and spicy 又辣又烫

ex.en: The message looked identical to the real one, except for one small detail.
ex.cn: 那条消息看上去和真的一模一样，只有一个小细节不同。
ex.note: be identical to 与…完全相同；identical twins 同卵双胞胎

ex.en: The importance of the class lies in habit, not in fear.
ex.cn: 这堂课的重要之处在于习惯，而不在于恐惧。
ex.note: the importance of … …的重要性；attach importance to 重视

ex.en: An aircraft factory once stood in the old industrial district.
ex.cn: 旧工业区里曾经矗立着一座飞机制造厂。
ex.note: industrial area 工业区；industrial production 工业生产

ex.en: You can insert a second check between the password and the account.
ex.cn: 你可以在密码和账户之间加一道二次验证。
ex.note: insert sth. into sth. 把…插入…

ex.en: The rules say we should not interfere with another team's machines.
ex.cn: 规定说我们不该干预另一支队伍的机器。
ex.note: interfere with 干涉；interfere in 干涉（某事）

ex.en: Each item on the list must be dealt with before Friday.
ex.cn: 清单上的每一项都必须在周五之前处理完。
ex.note: an item on a list 清单上的一项；items of clothing 衣物

ex.en: When one password opens every door, the campus becomes a jungle.
ex.cn: 当一个密码能打开所有的门，校园就成了丛林。
ex.note: the concrete jungle 水泥丛林

ex.en: Every student should know the first rule of password safety.
ex.cn: 每个学生都该知道密码安全的第一条规则。
ex.note: know about 了解；get to know 渐渐认识

ex.en: She left her laundry in the machine and forgot about it all morning.
ex.cn: 她把要洗的衣服留在洗衣机里，整个上午都忘了这回事。
ex.note: do the laundry 洗衣服；a laundry service 洗衣服务

ex.en: A glass of lemon water was waiting on the table.
ex.cn: 桌上放着一杯柠檬水。
ex.note: lemon juice 柠檬汁；lemonade 柠檬汽水

ex.en: The line of students waiting for tickets ran out of the door.
ex.cn: 排队买票的队伍一直排到了门外。
ex.note: stand in line 排队；a line of credit 信用额度

ex.en: We lined up at the counter to pay our course fees.
ex.cn: 我们在柜台前排队交学费。
ex.note: line up 排队；line the street 两边站满人

ex.en: Look at the shade of the colour in that logo before you trust it.
ex.cn: 在信任一个标志之前，先看看它颜色的深浅。
ex.note: look for 寻找；look into 调查；look as if 看起来像

ex.en: She gave him a quick look and decided to trust the poster.
ex.cn: 她飞快地看了他一眼，决定相信那张海报。
ex.note: a quick look 快速一看；a good look 好相貌

ex.en: A magnet on the fridge is enough to keep the key safe.
ex.cn: 冰箱上一块磁铁，就足以让钥匙安安全全。
ex.note: a magnet for … 对…有吸引力的事物

ex.en: The stall sold fruit from the market outside the gate.
ex.cn: 那个摊位卖的是门外市场运来的水果。
ex.note: a market for … …的市场；on the market 在市场上

ex.en: The business began to market its goods online in April.
ex.cn: 这家企业四月开始在网上销售自己的商品。
ex.note: market sth. to sb. 向某人推销；market share 市场份额

ex.en: A retired mechanic explained how an old lock worked.
ex.cn: 一位退休的机械师解释了一把老锁是怎么运作的。
ex.note: a car mechanic 汽车修理工

ex.en: They sat in the middle of the hall, close to the stage.
ex.cn: 他们坐在大厅中间，离舞台很近。
ex.note: in the middle of 在…中间；the middle of nowhere 偏远之地

ex.en: The middle rows of seats filled up first.
ex.cn: 中间几排座位最先坐满了。
ex.note: middle school 中学；the middle of the road 折中路线

ex.en: Do not mix up a real notice with a fake one.
ex.cn: 别把真通知和假通知混为一谈。
ex.note: mix up 混淆；mix with 与…混在一起

ex.en: The corridor was a mix of students, staff and hot tea.
ex.cn: 走廊里是学生、教职员和热茶混在一起的样子。
ex.note: a mix of … …的混合；a mixed bag 形形色色的一批

ex.en: The prize of a cup of tea was enough to motivate the whole team.
ex.cn: 一杯茶这样的奖赏就足以激励整支队伍。
ex.note: motivate sb. to do sth. 激励某人做某事

ex.en: He pressed a nail into the wall to hang the poster.
ex.cn: 他在墙上钉了一根钉子，好挂海报。
ex.note: a nail in the coffin 致命一击；fingernail 指甲

ex.en: The team nailed down every permission before the test began.
ex.cn: 测试开始前，团队把每一项权限都牢牢锁死。
ex.note: nail sth. down 把某事敲定；nail it 做到位

ex.en: Neither of the two answers was completely correct.
ex.cn: 这两个答案没有一个是完全正确的。
ex.note: neither of 两者都不；neither here nor there 不相干

ex.en: He did not write back, and she did not write either; neither did they speak.
ex.cn: 他没有回信，她也没有回；他们俩同样没有开口。
ex.note: neither … nor … 既不…也不…

ex.en: The list of common passwords was a parade of nonsense.
ex.cn: 那份常见密码清单是一串胡话。
ex.note: talk nonsense 说胡话；speak nonsense 讲废话

ex.en: Every member of the team agreed to obey the rules of the exercise.
ex.cn: 队伍里的每个人都同意遵守演练的规则。
ex.note: obey the law 遵守法律；obey orders 服从命令

ex.en: He often called his mother on Sunday evenings.
ex.cn: 他常常在周日晚上给母亲打电话。
ex.note: how often 多久一次

ex.en: The cake was made with oranges from the orchard behind the hall.
ex.cn: 蛋糕里放的是大厅后面果园里摘的橙子。
ex.note: orange juice 橙汁；a blood orange 血橙

ex.en: An orange stripe ran across the top of the poster.
ex.cn: 海报顶部横着一道橙色的条纹。
ex.note: orange peel 橙皮；orange light 橙色的灯光

ex.en: His outward calm hid a great deal of excitement.
ex.cn: 他外表的平静掩盖着大量的激动。
ex.note: outward calm 表面平静；outward appearance 外表

ex.en: A pale boy from the business school volunteered to go on stage.
ex.cn: 一个脸色苍白的商学院男生自告奋勇上了台。
ex.note: pale with fear 吓得脸色发白；pale grey 淡灰色

ex.en: He lost his passport on the deck and spent a week sorting out forms.
ex.cn: 他把护照丢在了甲板上，花了一个星期处理各种表格。
ex.note: a passport to success 通往成功的途径

ex.en: He cooked noodles with pepper sauce and slept well.
ex.cn: 他煮了一碗辣椒酱拌面，睡得很香。
ex.note: black pepper 黑胡椒；pepper sauce 辣酱

ex.en: He wrote the phone number on the back of a card.
ex.cn: 他把电话号码写在了一张卡片的背面。
ex.note: on the phone 在打电话；mobile phone 手机

ex.en: She phoned the bank as soon as she found the strange charge.
ex.cn: 她一发现那笔奇怪的扣款，就给银行打了电话。
ex.note: phone sb. 给某人打电话

ex.en: The blue team had ten minutes to draw up its plan.
ex.cn: 蓝队有十分钟时间拟出计划。
ex.note: a plan for … …的计划；the plan of a building 建筑平面图

ex.en: They planned to change the default password and add a second check.
ex.cn: 他们打算改掉默认密码，再加一道验证。
ex.note: plan to do 计划做；plan ahead 提前计划

ex.en: The policy is simple: follow the rules and report anything strange.
ex.cn: 这条方针很简单：遵守规定，报告一切可疑的事。
ex.note: insurance policy 保险单；on policy 按政策

ex.en: The message was possibly a trap, but nobody wanted to be the one to find out.
ex.cn: 那条消息可能是个陷阱，可没人愿意成为那个去弄清真相的人。
ex.note: possibly because 可能是因为

ex.en: In preparation, the red team was sent out of the room.
ex.cn: 作为准备，红队被请出了那间屋子。
ex.note: in preparation for 为…做准备

ex.en: Privacy is not a luxury, and protection is cheaper than punishment.
ex.cn: 隐私不是奢侈品，而保护比惩罚更省钱。
ex.note: invade sb.'s privacy 侵犯某人的隐私；in privacy 私下地

ex.en: He wanted to write a proper article for the student paper.
ex.cn: 他想为校报写一篇像样的文章。
ex.note: the proper way to do 做某事恰当的方式；proper noun 专有名词

ex.en: The punishment for the criminals was harsh, but the victims still carried the cost.
ex.cn: 对罪犯的惩罚很严厉，可代价还是由受害者承担。
ex.note: a punishment for … 对…的惩罚；capital punishment 死刑

ex.en: The scientist said the evidence did not support fears about radiation from phones.
ex.cn: 那位科学家说，证据并不支持对手机辐射的担忧。
ex.note: radiation from … …产生的辐射；radiation sickness 辐射病

ex.en: The blue team had to send a real message and find the false one.
ex.cn: 蓝队必须发出一条真消息，并找出那条假消息。
ex.note: real life 真实生活；for real 真的

ex.en: She referred to a book that anyone could check in the library.
ex.cn: 她提到了一本谁都能在图书馆查到的书。
ex.note: refer to 提到；refer to sb. for sth. 就某事询问某人

ex.en: A reliable friend is the best alarm system in the world.
ex.cn: 可靠的朋友是世上最好的报警系统。
ex.note: a reliable source 可靠的消息来源；reliable information 可靠的信息

ex.en: The card carried a phone number and a request to report anything strange.
ex.cn: 卡片上印着一个电话号码和一个请求：报告一切可疑的事。
ex.note: at sb.'s request 应某人的要求；make a request for 请求得到

ex.en: The company sells its goods to shops at wholesale prices and at retail prices.
ex.cn: 这家公司以批发价和零售价把商品卖给商店。
ex.note: the retail trade 零售业；retail price 零售价

ex.en: The rain roared on the concrete steps all evening.
ex.cn: 雨在水泥台阶上整夜轰鸣。
ex.note: a roar of laughter 一阵大笑；roar at sb. 对某人吼叫

ex.en: She drew the poster by hand with a wooden ruler.
ex.cn: 她用一把木尺手绘了那张海报。
ex.note: a powerful ruler 统治者；a ruler of 30 centimetres 三十厘米长的尺子

ex.en: The noodles came with a hot pepper sauce.
ex.cn: 面里浇着热辣酱。
ex.note: soy sauce 酱油；tomato sauce 番茄酱

ex.en: She scraped the old paint off the door with a knife.
ex.cn: 她用刀把门上的旧漆刮了下来。
ex.note: scrape sth. off … 把…从…刮下；scrape through 勉强通过

ex.en: The scrape of chairs sounded like applause when the class ended.
ex.cn: 下课时，椅子挪动的刮擦声听上去像一片掌声。
ex.note: a scrape 刮擦声；in a scrape 陷入困境

ex.en: The shop sells clothes on the internet and has a cashier page.
ex.cn: 这家店在网上卖衣服，还设了一个收银页面。
ex.note: sell out 售罄；sell sth. to sb. 把某物卖给某人

ex.en: In the shadow of the library he felt a warmth he did not name.
ex.cn: 在图书馆的阴影里，他感到一种没有去命名的暖意。
ex.note: in the shadow of 在…的阴影中；a shadow of 一点点

ex.en: The thief was shadowed by two plain-clothes officers.
ex.cn: 那名小偷被两名便衣警察跟踪。
ex.note: shadow sb. 跟踪某人；be shadowed by … 被…所笼罩

ex.en: He took a shot of the poster with his phone before he left.
ex.cn: 离开前，他用手机拍了一张海报的照片。
ex.note: take a shot 拍照；a shot of 一张…的照片

ex.en: Since June the university has held a security class every term.
ex.cn: 自六月以来，大学每学期都举办一次安全课。
ex.note: since + 时间点；since … 一般过去时

ex.en: He left the hall early and has not been seen since.
ex.cn: 他提前离开了礼堂，此后再没人见过他。
ex.note: ever since 从那以后；not since … 自从没有…

ex.en: The wet steps slid under his feet as he ran down them.
ex.cn: 他往下跑时，湿滑的台阶从脚下溜了过去。
ex.note: slide into 陷入；slide off 滑下；slide by 逝去

ex.en: A slide showed three boxes stacked like a cube.
ex.cn: 一张幻灯片上画着三个叠成立方体的盒子。
ex.note: a slide show 幻灯片演示；on the slide 在下滑

ex.en: After the rain the air felt soft and the street smelled of wet stone.
ex.cn: 雨后空气变得柔和，街上带着湿石头的气味。
ex.note: a soft voice 轻柔的嗓音；soft light 柔和的光线

ex.en: They could not verify the phone number from any source.
ex.cn: 他们无法从任何来源核实那个电话号码。
ex.note: a source of … …的来源；at source 在源头

ex.en: The bicycle wheels began to spin as she rode away.
ex.cn: 她骑走时，自行车轮子开始转起来。
ex.note: spin a story 编故事；spin round 转身

ex.en: They went for a spin in the car along the coast road.
ex.cn: 他们沿着滨海公路开车兜了一圈风。
ex.note: a spin 旋转；go for a spin 去兜风

ex.en: From a defensive standpoint, prevention is cheaper than punishment.
ex.cn: 从防守的角度看，预防比惩罚更省钱。
ex.note: from one's standpoint 从某人的立场看

ex.en: A red stocking hung in the shop window beside the winter coats.
ex.cn: 商店橱窗里挂着一只红长筒袜，就在冬装大衣旁边。
ex.note: a pair of stockings 一双长筒袜；圣诞节 stocking 圣诞袜

ex.en: The logo had a stripe of a slightly different shade.
ex.cn: 那个商标上有一道颜色略深的条纹。
ex.note: a stripe of grey 一道灰纹；stripes 条纹图案

ex.en: Sarah made a suggestion and the whole class agreed at once.
ex.cn: 萨拉提了一个建议，全班立刻表示赞同。
ex.note: at sb.'s suggestion 在某人的建议下

ex.en: The company sold its surplus stock at a low price.
ex.cn: 公司以低价把多余的存货卖了出去。
ex.note: a trade surplus 贸易顺差；surplus stock 过剩的存货

ex.en: They removed a surplus admin page that nobody used.
ex.cn: 他们删掉了一个没人用的多余管理页面。
ex.note: surplus capacity 过剩的产能；surplus labour 剩余劳动力

ex.en: She typed a password into a tablet connected to the screen.
ex.cn: 她在一台连着屏幕的平板电脑上输入了一个密码。
ex.note: a tablet of aspirin 一片阿司匹林；tablet computer 平板电脑

ex.en: The card carried a telephone number for reporting strange events.
ex.cn: 卡片上印着一个举报可疑事件的电话号码。
ex.note: telephone number 电话号码；by telephone 通过电话

ex.en: He telephoned the bank to ask about the missing money.
ex.cn: 他给银行打电话，询问那笔失踪的钱。
ex.note: telephone sb. 给某人打电话

ex.en: The security class was held in the old theater at the end of campus.
ex.cn: 这堂安全课在校园尽头的老剧院里举行。
ex.note: go to the theater 去看戏；theater of operations 战区

ex.en: Those who share one password share one weakness.
ex.cn: 共用一个密码的人，共用着同一个弱点。
ex.note: those who … 那些…的人；one of those 诸如此类

ex.en: He showed the class a tin box full of old wires.
ex.cn: 他给全班看了一只装满旧线路的锡盒。
ex.note: a tin of beans 一罐豆子；tin roof 铁皮屋顶

ex.en: The course is tough, but the tuition is low.
ex.cn: 这门课很难，但学费很低。
ex.note: a tough decision 艰难的决定；tough it out 硬撑到底

ex.en: A traveler who loses his passport may spend weeks sorting out forms.
ex.cn: 一个丢了护照的旅行者可能要花上几个星期处理各种表格。
ex.note: 英式拼写作 traveller

ex.en: The lecture takes place on Tuesday evening in the old hall.
ex.cn: 讲座在星期二晚上于老礼堂举行。
ex.note: on Tuesday 在星期二；next Tuesday 下周二

ex.en: She agreed to undertake the most difficult part of the exercise.
ex.cn: 她同意承担这次演练中最难的那一部分。
ex.note: undertake a task 承担一项任务；undertake to do 答应做

ex.en: The red team sent an urgent message that looked exactly like the real one.
ex.cn: 红队发来一条紧急消息，看上去和真的一模一样。
ex.note: an urgent matter 紧急的事；in urgent need 非常需要

ex.en: His mother asked whether he was eating enough vegetables.
ex.cn: 母亲问他蔬菜吃够了没有。
ex.note: green vegetables 青菜；vegetable oil 食用油

ex.en: She described her vision of a campus where everyone knew the first rule.
ex.cn: 她描述了她心中那幅图景：一所每个人都知道第一条规则的校园。
ex.note: a vision of … …的设想；have good vision 视力好

ex.en: He felt a warmth in the shadow of the library that he did not name.
ex.cn: 在图书馆的阴影里，他感到一种暖意，却不去说它是什么。
ex.note: the warmth of … …的温暖；with warmth 热情地

ex.en: Before you trust a message, weigh the risk against the reward.
ex.cn: 在信任一条消息之前，先权衡风险与收益。
ex.note: weigh A against B 权衡A与B；weigh up 仔细考虑

ex.en: You cannot wholly remove risk, but you can lower it.
ex.cn: 你不可能完全消除风险，但你可以把它降低。
ex.note: wholly different 完全不同；not wholly 并不完全

ex.en: If one path leads in, the wolf can walk everywhere.
ex.cn: 只要有一条路能进去，狼就能到处走。
ex.note: a wolf in sheep's clothing 披着羊皮的狼

ex.en: The writing on the old notice board was hard to read.
ex.cn: 旧公告板上的字迹很难辨认。
ex.note: writing practice 写作练习；in writing 书面地
